description: [Requires sign-in] Get a readiness check by id. While running, reports progress. When complete, reports whether personal agents could reach the page, understand it, and reach checkout, plus the wall, concrete next steps, a directional score, a per-agent breakdown, and screenshots. Calling this again with the same id redisplays the result and does not start a new check. Never re-run check_agent_readiness just to see the screenshots again.

id.description: The check id returned by check_agent_readiness.

name: get_readiness_result
